name: Config Route Requirements
description: Adds a `_config` route requirement; a route subscriber removes any route whose referenced config value(s) evaluate false at route-build time (404), toggling routes on/off from config.
project_description:
The Config Route Requirements module will allow module developers to easily provide an on/off toggle for routes using configuration values.

 For more information, please refer to the full documentation .

 Back to top 

 
Requirements 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.

 Back to top 

 
Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 
Configuration 
 The module has no menu or modifiable settings. There is no configuration.
